base1-1.name: Alakazam
base1-1.description: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

abilities.name: Damage Swap
abilities.effect: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to another as long as you don't Knock Out that Pokémon. This power can't be used if Alakazam is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

base1-2.name: Blastoise

abilities.effect: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach 1 Water Energy Card to 1 of your Water Pokémon. (This doesn't use up your 1 Energy card attachment for the turn.) This power can't be used if Blastoise is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.effect: Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each attached Water Energy attached to Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Extra Water Energy after the 2nd doesn't count.

base1-3.name: Chansey

attacks.name: Scrunch
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Chansey during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Double-edge
attacks.effect: Chansey does 80 damage to itself.

base1-4.name: Charizard

abilities.name: Energy Burn
abilities.effect: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may turn all Energy attached to Charizard into Fire Energy for the rest of the turn. This power can't be used if Charizard is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.effect: Discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard in order to use this attack.

base1-5.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Sing
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Metronome
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of Defending Pokémon's attacks. Metronome copies that attack except for its Energy costs and anything else required in order to use that attack, such as discarding energy cards. (No matter what type the defender is, Clefairy's type is still Colorless.)

base1-6.name: Gyarados

attacks.name: Bubblebeam

Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 3 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 3 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

gym2-113.name: Cinnabar City Gym
gym2-113.effect: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Ignore Weakness when a Water Pokémon does damage to a Pokémon with Blaine in its name.

gym2-114.name: Fuchsia City Gym
gym2-114.effect: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. If heads, that player may shuffle 1 of his or her Pokémon in play with Koga in its name and any cards attached to it into his or her deck.

gym2-115.name: Koga's Ninja Trick
gym2-115.effect: Attach Koga's Ninja Trick to your Active Pokémon with Koga in its name. If this Pokémon goes to your Bench, discard this card. When your opponent attacks, you may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon (before damage or other effects of attacks).

gym2-116.name: Master Ball
gym2-116.effect: Look at 7 cards from the top of your deck. You may choose a Basic Pokémon or Evolution card from those cards, show it to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle the rest into your deck.

gym2-117.name: Max Revive
gym2-117.effect: Discard 2 Energy cards from your hand in order to put 1 Basic Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench. (You can't play Max Revive if your Bench is full.)

gym2-118.name: Misty's Tears
gym2-118.effect: Discard 1 of the other cards in your hand in order to search your deck for up to 2 Water Energy cards. Show those cards to your opponent, then put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

gym2-119.name: Rocket's Minefield Gym
gym2-119.effect: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Whenever a player puts a Basic Pokémon onto his or her Bench from his or her hand, he or she flips a coin. If tails, put damage counters on that Pokémon.

gym2-120.name: Rocket's Secret Experiment
gym2-120.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If tails, you can't play Trainer cards until the end of your next turn.

gym2-121.name: Sabrina's Psychic Control
gym2-121.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a Trainer card in your opponent's discard pile that isn't put in play (like PlusPower or Mysterious Fossil). You may use that card as if it were in your hand, if you do everything required in order to play that card (like discarding cards). The card stays in your opponent's discard pile.

gym2-122.name: Saffron City Gym
gym2-122.effect: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. As often as each player like during his or her turn (before attacking), that player may return 1 basic Energy card attached to 1 of his or her Pokémon with Sabrina in its name to his or her hand.

gym2-123.name: Viridian City Gym
gym2-123.effect: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Whenever a Pokémon with Giovanni in its name evolves, its owner removes 2 damage counters from that Pokémon (or 1 if it only has 1).

gym2-124.name: Fervor
gym2-124.effect: Show the top 3 cards of your deck to all players. Put any Fire Energy cards there into your hand and discard the rest.

gym2-125.name: Transparent Walls
gym2-125.effect: Until the end of your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from attacks done to your Benched Pokémon. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

gym2-126.name: Warp Point
gym2-126.effect: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with his or her Active Pokémon, then, if you have any Benched Pokémon, you switch 1 of them with your Active Pokémon.

neo1-1.name: Ampharos
neo1-1.description: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

attacks.name: Gigaspark
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

neo1-2.name: Azumarill
neo1-2.description: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers.

attacks.name: Bubble Shower
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

neo1-3.name: Bellossom
neo1-3.description: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

attacks.name: Sweet Nectar
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flower Dance
attacks.effect: Does 30 damage times the number of cards with Bellossom in their names that you have in play (including this one).

neo1-4.name: Feraligatr
neo1-4.description: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.effect: When you play Feraligatr from your hand, flip a coin. If heads, discard the top 5 cards from your opponent's deck. If tails, discard the top 5 cards from your deck.

attacks.name: Chomp
attacks.effect: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of damage counters on Feraligatr. This attack does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.

neo1-5.name: Feraligatr
neo1-5.description: It is hard for it to support its own weight out of water, so it gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.

attacks.name: Riptide
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage plus 10 damage times the number of Energy cards in your discard pile. Then, shuffle all Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

neo1-6.name: Heracross
neo1-6.description: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

abilities.name: Final Blow
abilities.effect: If Heracross's remaining HP are 20 or less, you may make its Megahorn attack's base damage 120 instead of 60. This power can't be used if Heracross is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Megahorn
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

neo1-7.name: Jumpluff
neo1-7.description: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.effect: If this attack damages the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), remove 1 damage counter from Jumpluff, if it has any.

neo1-8.name: Kingdra
neo1-8.description: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Kingdra.

attacks.name: Dragon Tornado
attacks.effect: If this attack doesn't Knock Out the Defending Pokémon, and if there are any Pokémon on your opponent's Bench, choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

neo1-9.name: Lugia
neo1-9.description: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea, because its powers are too strong.

attacks.name: Elemental Blast
attacks.effect: Discard a Energy card, a Energy card, and a Energy card attached to Lugia in order to use this attack.

neo1-10.name: Meganium
neo1-10.description: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

abilities.name: Herbal Scent
abilities.effect: When you play Meganium from your hand, you may flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from all Grass Pokémon in play.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

neo1-11.name: Meganium
neo1-11.description: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

abilities.name: Wild Growth
abilities.effect: As long as Meganium is in play, each Grass Energy card attached to your Grass Pokémon instead provides GrassGrass. This power stops working while Meganium is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Soothing Scent
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

neo1-12.name: Pichu
neo1-12.description: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

attacks.name: Zzzap
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage to each Pokémon in play that has a Pokémon Power. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

neo1-13.name: Skarmory
neo1-13.description: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.

attacks.name: Claw
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Steel Wing
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, all damage done by attacks to Skarmory during your opponent's next turn is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

neo1-14.name: Slowking

attacks.name: Mind Blast
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, this attack does 20 damage.

neo1-15.name: Steelix
neo1-15.description: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

attacks.name: Tail Crush
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage.

neo1-16.name: Togetic
neo1-16.description: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

attacks.name: Super Metronome
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, choose an attack of 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Super Metronome copies that attack except for its Energy cost. (You must still do anything else in order to use that attack.) (No matter what type the Defending Pokémon is, Togetic's type is still .) Togetic performs that attack. (Togetic can make that attack even if it does not have the appropriate number or type of Energy attached to it necessary to make the attack.)

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Togetic; if tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

attacks.name: Flame Burst

attacks.name: Flame Wheel

neo1-19.name: Metal Energy
neo1-19.effect:
Damage done to the Pokémon Metal Energy is attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). If the Pokémon Metal Energy is attached to isn't Metal, whenever it damages a Pokémon, reduce that damage by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
Metal Energy provides Metal Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

neo1-20.name: Cleffa

attacks.name: Eeeeeeek
attacks.effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw 7 cards.

neo1-21.name: Donphan

attacks.name: Flail

attacks.effect: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with his or her Active Pokémon, then, if you have any Benched Pokémon, you switch 1 of them with your Active Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

neo1-22.name: Elekid
neo1-22.description: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.

abilities.name: Playful Punch
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, do 20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon. (Apply Weakness and Resistance.) Either way, this ends your turn. This power can't be used if Elekid is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

neo1-23.name: Magby
neo1-23.description: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.

attacks.name: Sputter

neo1-24.name: Murkrow

attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat as long as Murkrow remains your Active Pokémon. (Benching or evolving either Pokémon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Feint Attack

neo1-25.name: Sneasel

attacks.name: Beat Up

attacks.name: Tail Rap
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

neo1-27.name: Ariados

attacks.name: Spider Web
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. (Benching or evolving that Pokémon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Poison Bite
attacks.effect: If this attack damages the Defending Pokémon, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned and you remove a number of damage counters from Ariados equal to half that damage (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Ariados has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

neo1-28.name: Bayleef
neo1-28.description: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Pollen Shield
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, Bayleef can't become Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. (All other effects of attacks, Pokémon Powers, and Trainer cards still happen.)

neo1-29.name: Bayleef
neo1-29.description: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.

attacks.name: Sweet Scent
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads and if any of your Pokémon have any damage counters on them, then remove 2 damage counters from 1 of them (or 1 if it only has 1). If tails and if any of your opponent's Pokémon have any damage counters on them, choose 1 of them and remove 2 damage counters from it (or 1 if it only has 1).

attacks.name: Double Razor Leaf
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

neo1-30.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Squaredance

neo1-31.name: Croconaw

attacks.effect: Until the end of your next turn, if an attack damages the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Jaw Clamp
attacks.effect: Until the end of your opponent's next turn, as long as Croconaw is your Active Pokémon, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat, and if the effect of an attack, Pokémon Power, or Trainer card would change that player's Active Pokémon, that part of the effect does nothing.

attacks.name: Sweep Away
attacks.effect: Discard the top 3 cards from your deck.

neo1-33.name: Electabuzz

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.effect: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokémon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Electric Current
attacks.effect: Take 1 Energy card attached to Flaaffy and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you have no Benched Pokémon, discard that Energy card.

neo1-35.name: Furret
neo1-35.description: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

neo1-36.name: Gloom

attacks.name: Strange Powder
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused; if tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Sticky Nectar
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage and, until the end of your opponent's next turn, as long as Gloom is your Active Pokémon, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat, and if the effect of an attack, Pokémon Power, or Trainer card would change that player's Active Pokémon, that part of the effect does nothing. If tails, this attack does 20 damage.

neo1-37.name: Granbull

attacks.name: Raging Charge
attacks.effect: This attack does 10 damage plus 10 damage for each damage counter on Granbull. Then, Granbull does 20 damage to itself.

neo1-38.name: Lanturn

attacks.name: Floodlight
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

neo1-39.name: Ledian

attacks.name: Baton Pass

neo1-40.name: Magmar
neo1-40.description: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

neo1-41.name: Miltank

attacks.name: Milk Drink

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

abilities.name: Glaring Gaze

Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck. This power can't be used if Noctowl is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

neo1-43.name: Phanpy

attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, then if, during your opponent's next turn, Phanpy would be Knocked Out by an attack, Phanpy isn't Knocked Out and its remaining HP become 10 instead.

neo1-44.name: Piloswine
neo1-44.description: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

neo1-45.name: Quagsire

attacks.effect: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy cards attached to Dark Tyranitar. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. Then, for each heads, discard the top card from your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Fling Away
attacks.effect: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, this attack does 30 damage instead of 50 and choose 1 of those Benched Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

neo4-12.name: Light Arcanine

abilities.name: Drive Off
abilities.effect: As long as Light Arcanine is your Active Pokémon, once during your turn (before your attack), if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. attacks.name: Gentle Flames
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon is a Baby Pokémon, this attack does 10 damage instead of 50. If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, this attack does 30 damage instead of 50.

neo4-13.name: Light Azumarill
neo4-13.description: It curls up its long ears when swimming to prevent water from entering them.

attacks.name: Bubble

neo4-14.name: Light Dragonite
neo4-14.description: It is said to fly constantly over the sea, looking for people in need of aid.

abilities.name: Miraculous Wind
abilities.effect: As long as Light Dragonite is your Active Pokémon, each Special Energy card provides Colorless Energy instead of its usual type and its other effects stop working. This power stops working while Light Dragonite is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Light Wave
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks that are not damage done to this Pokémon.

neo4-15.name: Light Togetic
neo4-15.description: It becomes depressed if it is not near kind-hearted people. Is is able to float in the air without moving its wings.

attacks.name: Sweet Kiss
attacks.effect: Your opponent may draw a card.

neo4-16.name: Miracle Energy
neo4-16.effect:
You can't have more than 1 Miracle Energy in your deck. Attach Miracle Energy to 1 of your Shining or Light Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard Miracle Energy.
While in play, Miracle Energy counts as every type of Energy but provides only 2 Energy at a time.

neo4-17.name: Dark Ariados
neo4-17.description: Wherever it goes, it spins a thread that always leads back to its web.

attacks.name: Entangle
attacks.effect: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon, then flip a coin. If heads, the new Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Poison Bind
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Flip a coin. neo4-18.name: Dark Magcargo
neo4-18.description: The shell on its back comes off easily, exposing the flames running through its body.

attacks.name: Ball of Flame
attacks.effect: You may discard a Energy card attached to Dark Magcargo when you use this attack. If you do and if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 20 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

neo4-19.name: Dark Omastar
neo4-19.description: Nothing can escape once wrapped in its tentacles, which it uses for self-defense as well as to catch food.

attacks.name: Dark Tentacle
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't evolve except from effects of attacks or Pokémon Powers. (Benching that Pokémon ends this effect.)

neo4-20.name: Dark Slowking

attacks.name: Mind Shock
attacks.effect: Don't apply Weakness or Resistance for this attack.

neo4-21.name: Dark Ursaring
neo4-21.description: Its keen nose can pick out any scent, even that of food buried deep underground.

attacks.name: Battle Frenzy
attacks.effect: For each Pokémon in play (yours and your opponent's), flip a coin. For each heads, this attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack.

neo4-22.name: Light Dragonair
neo4-22.description: The aura it projects from its body has an effect on the surrounding climate and weather.

neo4-23.name: Light Lanturn

neo4-31.name: Chansey
neo4-31.description: It holds its egg carefully when moving so as not to break it. Still, it is fast enough to disappear in the blink of an eye.

neo4-33.name: Dark Exeggutor

attacks.effect: Discard a Energy card attached to Light Ninetales in order to use this attack.

attacks.name: Synchronize

neo4-54.name: Light Wigglytuff
neo4-54.description: If two of them brush against each other, they will not be able to separate themselves, as they enjoy touching each other's soft fur too much.

attacks.name: Body Slam

neo4-60.name: Unown [Z]

neo4-61.name: Cyndaquil

neo4-63.name: Dratini

attacks.name: Fury Attack

neo4-64.name: Exeggcute

neo4-79.name: Psyduck

neo4-81.name: Seel

neo4-82.name: Slugma

neo4-88.description: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

attacks.name: Poisonpowder

neo4-93.name: EXP.ALL
neo4-93.effect: Attach EXP.ALL to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. During your opponent's turn, if your Active Pokémon would be Knocked Out by your opponent's attack, you may take 1 of the basic Energy cards attached to your Active Pokémon and attach it to the Pokémon with EXP.ALL attached to it. If you do, discard EXP.ALL.

neo4-94.name: Impostor Professor Oak's Invention
neo4-94.effect: Look at your opponent's Prize cards. You may have your opponent shuffle them into his or her deck. If you do, your opponent takes that many cards from the top of his or her deck and sets them aside as his or her new Prize cards (without looking at them).

neo4-95.name: Radio Tower
neo4-95.effect: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may look at the top 2 cards of his or her deck and put them back in the same order.

neo4-96.name: Thought Wave Machine (Rocket's Secret Machine)
neo4-96.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, return an Energy card attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon to your opponent's hand. If the Pokémon has fewer attached Energy cards than that, return all of them to your opponent's hand. Your turn is over now (you don't get to attack).

neo4-97.name: Counterattack Claws
neo4-97.effect: Attach Counterattack Claws to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. During your opponent's turn, if the Pokémon Counterattack Claws is attached to is your Active Pokémon and an opponent's attack damages it (even if it is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. Then, discard Counterattack Claws.

neo4-98.name: Energy Amplifier
neo4-98.effect: Choose an Energy card in your hand, show it to your opponent, and shuffle it into your deck. Then flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

neo4-99.name: Energy Stadium
neo4-99.effect: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. If heads, that player puts a basic Energy card from his or her discard pile into his or her hand.

neo4-100.name: Lucky Stadium
neo4-100.effect: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. If heads, that player draws a card.

neo4-101.name: Magnifier
neo4-101.effect: Attach Magnifier to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard Magnifier. If the Pokémon Magnifier is attached to attacks, don't apply Resistance for that attack.

neo4-102.name: Pokémon Personality Test
neo4-102.effect: Put an Evolution card from your hand face down in front of you. Your opponent guesses whether it is a Pokémon card with Light in its name, a Pokémon card with Dark in its name, or neither one. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 3 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 3 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

neo4-103.name: Team Rocket's Evil Deeds
neo4-103.effect: Look at your opponent's hand and choose a card there. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck. Then, your opponent may draw up to 2 cards.

neo4-104.name: Heal Powder
neo4-104.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned and remove 2 damage counters from it. If your Active Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

neo4-105.name: Mail from Bill
neo4-105.effect: You can't play this card if you have 5 or more cards in your hand (including this one). Draw cards until you have exactly 4 cards in your hand.

neo4-106.name: Shining Celebi
neo4-106.description: It is worshipped as a god of the forest. It appears only in undisturbed old-growth forests.

attacks.name: Healing Water
attacks.effect: Remove a number of damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon equal to the number of Energy cards attached to Shining Celebi. If the Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

attacks.name: Miracle Leaf
attacks.effect: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. If you get 1 or more heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep, Confused, or Poisoned (your choice).

attacks.name: Water Slash

dp2-3.name: Ambipom

attacks.effect: Your opponent flips a coin until he or she gets heads. For each tails, remove an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and put it on the bottom of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Charity Tail
attacks.effect: Before Ambipom does damage, your opponent may discard 2 cards from his or her hand. If he or she does, this attack's base damage is 10 instead of 80.

dp2-4.name: Azelf
dp2-4.description: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

abilities.name: Downer Material
abilities.effect: If you have Uxie and Mesprit in play, the attack cost of each of your opponent's Basic Pokémon's attack is Colorless more. You can't use more than 1 Downer Material Poké-Body each turn.

attacks.name: Bind Pulse
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, your opponent can't attach any Special Energy cards from his or her hand to any of his or her Pokémon.

dp2-5.name: Blissey
dp2-5.description: This kindhearted Pokémon nurses sick Pokémon to health. It senses feelings of sadness.

abilities.name: Kind Egg
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Happiny is anywhere under Blissey, you may choose a number of cards in your hand up to the amount of Energy attached to Blissey and put those cards on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. Then, draw that many cards. This power can't be used if Blissey is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Happy Chance
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to Blissey. Before doing damage, you may search your discard pile for a basic Energy card and attach it to Blissey.

dp2-6.name: Bronzong
dp2-6.description: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

abilities.name: Miracle Oracle
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw a card. Then, discard a card from your hand. If you discard an Energy card, draw 1 more card. This power can't be used if Bronzong is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Shady Stamp
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

dp2-7.name: Celebi
dp2-7.description: It has the power to travel across time, but is is said to appear only in peaceful times.

attacks.name: Sprouting
attacks.effect: Search your deck for a Grass Energy card and attach it to Celebi. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Leaf Tornado
attacks.effect: You may move any number of basic Grass Energy cards attached to your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

dp2-8.name: Feraligatr
dp2-8.description: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

attacks.name: Breaking Tail
attacks.effect: Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it.

dp2-9.name: Garchomp

dp2-10.name: Honchkrow

attacks.name: Dark Wing Flaps

dp2-11.name: Lumineon
dp2-11.description: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

dp2-12.name: Magmortar
dp2-12.description: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

dp2-13.name: Meganium

attacks.effect: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Aqua Ring
attacks.effect: Switch Manaphy with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

pop6-4.name: Pachirisu
pop6-4.description: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

attacks.name: Minor Errand-Running
attacks.effect: Search your deck for a basic Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, Pachirisu does 10 damage to itself.

pop6-5.name: Rampardos
pop6-5.description: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

attacks.name: Assurance
attacks.effect: As long as the Defending Pokémon’s remaining HP is 60 or less, this attack’s base damage is 60 instead of 30.

attacks.name: Hasty Headbutt
attacks.effect: Rampardos does 20 damage to itself. This attack’s damage isn’t affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

pop6-6.name: Drifloon
pop6-6.description: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

attacks.name: Blowing Wind
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, put 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to it on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Ominous Wind
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused and can’t retreat during your opponent’s next turn.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

pop6-8.name: Riolu
pop6-8.description: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

attacks.name: Wild Kick
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Spark
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage to 2 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

pop6-10.name: Staravia
pop6-10.description: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.effect: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon can’t retreat during your opponent’s next turn.

pop6-11.name: Bidoof
pop6-11.description: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

attacks.name: Amnesia
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon’s attacks. That Pokémon can’t use that attack during your opponent’s next turn.

attacks.name: Scavenge
attacks.effect: Search your discard pile for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand.

pop6-12.name: Buneary
pop6-12.description: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling is rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

attacks.name: Jump Kick
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

pop6-13.name: Cherubi
pop6-13.description: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.effect: If this attack does any damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), remove 1 damage counter from Cherubi.

pop6-14.name: Chimchar
pop6-14.description: It agilely scales cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to Chimchar.

pop6-15.name: Piplup
pop6-15.description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

attacks.name: Water Splash
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

pop6-16.name: Starly
pop6-16.description: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

pop6-17.name: Turtwig
pop6-17.description: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

dp3-1.name: Ampharos
dp3-1.description: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

abilities.name: Jamming
abilities.effect: After your opponent plays a Supporter card from his or her hand, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon. You can't use more than 1 Jamming Poké-Body each turn.

attacks.name: Cluster Bolt
attacks.effect: You may discard all Lightning Energy attached to Ampharos. If you do, this attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any Energy cards attached to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

dp3-2.name: Blastoise
dp3-2.description: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

abilities.name: Waterlog
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach as many basic Water Energy cards from your hand to any of your Pokémon in any way you like. If you do, your turn ends. This power can't be used if Blastoise is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.effect: Does 50 damage plus 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 40 damage in this way.

dp3-3.name: Charizard
dp3-3.description: It is said that CHARIZARD's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

abilities.name: Fury Blaze
abilities.effect: If your opponent has 3 or less Prize cards left, each of Charizard's attacks does 50 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Blast Burn
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard. If tails, discard 4 Energy cards attached to Charizard. (If you can't, this attack does nothing.)

dp3-4.name: Entei
dp3-4.description: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

abilities.name: Burning Coat
abilities.effect: Whenever 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from Entei's attacks, discard the top 3 cards from your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Blaze Roar
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Flip a coin. If tails, discard 2 Fire Energy attached to Entei.

dp3-5.name: Flygon
dp3-5.description: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as "The Desert Spirit."

abilities.name: Irritating Buzz
abilities.effect: As long as Flygon is your Active Pokémon, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Active Pokémon between turns, excluding Fighting Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sand Sonic
attacks.effect: If you attach a Fighting Energy card from your hand to Flygon during this turn, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage.

dp3-6.name: Gallade
dp3-6.description: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

attacks.name: Sonic Blade
attacks.effect: Put damage counters on the Defending Pokémon until it is 50 HP away from being Knocked Out. If you do, your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic Cut
attacks.effect: You may choose as many of your face-down Prize cards as you like and put them face up. If you do, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage for each Prize card you chose. (These cards remain face up for the rest of the game.)

dp3-7.name: Gardevoir
dp3-7.description: It will try to guard its trusted Trainer with its life. It has the ability to see the future.

abilities.name: Telepass
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your opponent's discard pile for a Supporter card and use the effect of that card as the effect of this power. (The Supporter card remains in your opponent's discard pile.)  You can't use more than 1 Telepass Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Gardevoir is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Psychic Lock
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, your opponent can't use any Poké-Powers on his or her Pokémon.

dp3-8.name: Gastrodon East Sea
dp3-8.description: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

abilities.name: Osmosis
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Gastrodon West Sea in play, you may move up to 3 damage counters from Gastrodon East Sea to 1 of your Gastrodon West Sea.

attacks.name: Dwindling Wave
attacks.effect: Does 80 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on Gastrodon East Sea.

dp3-9.name: Gastrodon West Sea
dp3-9.description: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

attacks.name: Raging Flood
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Gastrodon West Sea. Then, remove 2 damage counters from Gastrodon West Sea.

attacks.name: Wild Waves
attacks.effect: Put 1 damage counter on each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

dp3-10.name: Ho-Oh
dp3-10.description: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.

abilities.name: Phoenix Turn
abilities.effect: Once during your opponent's turn, if Ho-Oh would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, you may flip a coin. If heads, Ho-Oh isn't discarded. Instead, remove all damage counters, Special Conditions, and other effects from Ho-Oh. Then, discard all cards attached to Ho-Oh (except for Energy cards). This counts as Ho-Oh being Knocked Out and your opponent takes a Prize card.

attacks.name: Rainbow Wing
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 damage times the number of different types of basic Energy cards attached to Ho-Oh.

dp3-11.name: Jumpluff
dp3-11.description: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

abilities.name: Cotton Spore
abilities.effect: Whenever Jumpluff would be damaged by your opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Jumpluff by that attack.

attacks.name: Cottonweed Punch
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. For each heads, this attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

dp3-12.name: Lickilicky
dp3-12.description: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting to close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

attacks.name: Tongue Reel
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you choose a Benched Pokémon, switch the Defending Pokémon with that Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to the Pokémon you chose. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.effect: During your next turn, Lickilicky can't attack.

dp3-13.name: Ludicolo
dp3-13.description: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

abilities.name: Rain Dish
abilities.effect: At any time between turns, remove 1 damage counter from Ludicolo.

attacks.name: Nature Power
attacks.effect: If you have a Stadium card in play, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage. If your opponent has a Stadium card in play, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

dp3-14.name: Lugia
dp3-14.description: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

attacks.name: Silver Wing
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, choose an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and return it to your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Psychic Destruction
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, this attack's base damage is 40 instead of 120.

dp3-15.name: Mew
dp3-15.description: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe MEW to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic Balance
attacks.effect: If you have less cards in your hand than your opponent, draw cards until you have the same number of cards as your opponent. (If you have more or the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does nothing.)

attacks.name: Re-creation
attacks.effect: Choose an attack on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon in his or her discard pile. Re-creation copies that attack except for its Energy cost. (You must still do anything else required for that attack.) Mew performs that attack.

dp3-16.name: Raikou
dp3-16.description: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.

abilities.name: Thunder Rumble
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you attach a Lightning Energy card from your hand to Raikou, you may put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunder Climb
attacks.effect: Discard 3 cards from the top of your deck. This attack does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each Lightning Energy card you discarded. Then, attach those Lightning Energy cards to 1 of your Pokémon.

dp3-17.name: Roserade
dp3-17.description: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

attacks.name: Sleep Poison
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Magical Leaf
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage and remove 3 damage counters from Roserade.

dp3-18.name: Salamence
dp3-18.description: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changes, and wings grew out.

attacks.name: Direct Hit
attacks.effect: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Finish
attacks.effect: Discard 2 basic Fire Energy cards or 2 basic Water Energy cards attached to Salamence. If you discarded 2 basic Fire Energy cards, this attack does 100 damage to the Defending Pokémon. If you discarded 2 basic Water Energy cards, this attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (If you can't discard cards, this attack does nothing.)

dp3-19.name: Suicune
dp3-19.description: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

abilities.name: Aqua Recovery
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you put Suicune from your hand onto your Bench, you may search your discard pile for up to 3 Water Pokémon, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand.

attacks.name: Cure Stream
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

dp3-20.name: Venusaur
dp3-20.description: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

abilities.name: Miracle Aroma
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, choose either Asleep, Burned, or Poisoned. The Defending Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition. This power can't be used if Venusaur is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Giant Bloom
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, remove 4 damage counters from Venusaur.

dp3-21.name: Absol
dp3-21.description: It senses disasters coming and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.

attacks.name: Baleful Wind
attacks.effect: Choose a card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it. If you discarded a Trainer, Supporter, or Stadium card, choose 1 more card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it.

attacks.name: Dark Raid
attacks.effect: If you played Absol from your hand during this turn, this attack's base damage is 40 instead of 10.

dp3-22.name: Arcanine
dp3-22.description: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

abilities.name: Flame Dash
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you play Arcanine from your hand to evolve 1 of your Benched Pokémon, you may switch Arcanine with 1 of your Active Pokémon. If you do, you may move any number of Energy cards attached to that Pokémon to Arcanine.

attacks.name: Inferno Onrush
attacks.effect: Arcanine does 40 damage to itself.

dp3-23.name: Banette
dp3-23.description: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.

attacks.name: Ghost Head
attacks.effect: Put as many damage counters as you like on Banette. (You can't put more than Banette's remaining HP.) Put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spiteful Pain
attacks.effect: If Banette is in your discard pile, this attack does 40 damage plus 40 more damage. Then, search your discard pile for Banette, show it to your opponent, and shuffle it into your deck.

dp3-24.name: Dugtrio
dp3-24.description: Its three heads moves alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

attacks.name: Dig Trap
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Dugtrio during your opponent's next turn. If Dugtrio is your Active Pokémon at the end of your opponent's next turn, put 6 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pit Trap
attacks.effect: Your opponent flips a coin. If tails, this attack does 50 damage plus 50 more damage.

dp3-25.name: Electivire
dp3-25.description: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

abilities.name: Motor Drive
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your discard pile for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to Electivire. This power can't be used if Electivire is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Discharge
attacks.effect: Discard all Lightning Energy attached to Electivire. Flip a coin for each Lightning Energy you discarded. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

dp3-26.name: Electrode
dp3-26.description: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

abilities.name: Energy Shift
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if Electrode would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, you may use this power. Electrode isn't discarded. Instead, attach it as an Energy card to 1 of your Pokémon. While attached, this card is a Special Energy card and provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.)

attacks.name: Ion Blast
attacks.effect: You may do 40 damage plus 60 more damage. If you do, Electrode does 100 damage to itself.

dp3-27.name: Furret
dp3-27.description: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

attacks.name: Keen Eye
attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Baton Pass
attacks.effect: You may switch Furret with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, move as many Energy cards attached to Furret as you like to the new Active Pokémon.

dp3-28.name: Golduck
dp3-28.description: A Pokémon that lives in lakes. It swims faster than any human swimming champion.

attacks.name: Encore
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can use only that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Break Beam
attacks.effect: You may do 40 damage plus 20 more damage. If you do, Golduck is now Confused.

dp3-29.name: Golem
dp3-29.description: It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulderlike body is so tough, even dynamite can't harm it.

attacks.name: Double Throw
attacks.effect: Choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Megaton Rock
attacks.effect: You may do 40 damage instead of 80 to the Defending Pokémon. If you do, during your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Golem by attacks is reduced by 40 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

dp3-30.name: Jynx
dp3-30.description: It cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

attacks.name: Icy Kiss
attacks.effect: If Jynx was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Lovely Kiss
attacks.effect: Move 2 damage counters from Jynx to the Defending Pokémon. If Smoochum is anywhere under Jynx, move 4 damage counters instead.

dp3-31.name: Magmortar
dp3-31.description: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

abilities.name: Flame Body
abilities.effect: When you attach a Fire Energy card from your hand to Magmortar, remove 2 damage counters from Magmortar.

attacks.name: Flame Blast
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage times the number of Fire Energy attached to Magmortar.

attacks.name: Fireball Bazooka
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

dp3-32.name: Minun
dp3-32.description: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

abilities.name: Minus Charge
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may draw 2 cards. You can't use more than 1 Minus Charge Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Minun is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Tag Play (-)
attacks.effect: If you have Plusle on your Bench, you may move an Energy card attached to Minun to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

dp3-33.name: Mothim
dp3-33.description: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.

attacks.name: Silver Wind
attacks.effect: During your next turn, if an attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does 40 more damage.

attacks.name: Raging Scales
attacks.effect: If Mothim has any damage counters on it, this attack does 30 damage plus 40 more damage.

dp3-34.name: Nidoking
dp3-34.description: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

attacks.name: Poison Rub
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Before doing damage, you may switch 1 of the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. The new Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Pride Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin for each Nidoqueen on your Bench. This attack does 60 damage plus 30 more damage for each heads.

dp3-35.name: Pidgeot
dp3-35.description: By flapping its wings with all its might, PIDGEOT can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.

attacks.name: Mirror Move
attacks.effect: If Pidgeot was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does the same amount of damage done to Pidgeot to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.effect: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

dp3-36.name: Plusle
dp3-36.description: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

abilities.name: Plus Charge
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may search your discard pile for up to 2 basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. You can't use more than 1 Plus Charge Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Plusle is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Tag Play (+)
attacks.effect: If you have Minun on your Bench, you may do 20 damage to any 1 Benched Pokémon instead. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

dp3-37.name: Sharpedo
dp3-37.description: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as "The Bully of the Sea."

abilities.name: Rough Skin
abilities.effect: If Sharpedo is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if Sharpedo is Knocked Out), put 2 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Strike Wound
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon has 2 or more damage counters on it, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on that Pokémon.

dp3-38.name: Sunflora
dp3-38.description: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

abilities.name: Grass Whistle
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may remove 1 damage counter from each of your Grass Pokémon. You can't use more than 1 Grass Whistle Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Sunflora is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Petal Dance
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. If you get 2 or more heads, Sunflora is now Confused.

dp3-39.name: Unown S
dp3-39.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

abilities.name: SET
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Unown S, Unown E, and Unown T on your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, search your discard pile for an Energy card, show it your opponent, and put it on top of your deck.

attacks.name: Hidden Power
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

dp3-40.name: Weavile
dp3-40.description: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

abilities.name: Dark Engage
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this power. Each of your Active Pokémon's type is Darkness until the end of your turn. If that Pokémon is no longer your Active Pokémon, this effect ends.

attacks.name: Shadow Charge
attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 2 Darkness Energy cards and attach them to any of your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Chip Off
attacks.effect: If your opponent has 6 or more cards in his or her hand, discard a number of cards without looking until your opponent has 5 cards left in his or her hand.

dp3-41.name: Wormadam Plant Cloak
dp3-41.description: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

abilities.name: Plant Cloak
abilities.effect: If Wormadam Plant Cloak has 2 or more Grass Energy attached to it, Wormadam Plant Cloak gets +40 HP.

attacks.name: Leaf Hurricane
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon has fewer remaining HP than Wormadam Plant Cloak, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

dp3-42.name: Wormadam Sandy Cloak
dp3-42.description: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

abilities.name: Sandy Cloak
abilities.effect: Prevent all effects of attacks, excluding damage, done to Wormadam Sandy Cloak.

attacks.name: Push Over
attacks.effect: Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each Fighting Energy attached to Wormadam Sandy Cloak.

dp3-43.name: Wormadam Trash Cloak
dp3-43.description: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

abilities.name: Trash Cloak
abilities.effect: If Wormadam Trash Cloak has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, any damage done to Wormadam Trash Cloak by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Iron Tackle
attacks.effect: Wormadam Trash Cloak does 20 damage to itself.

dp3-44.name: Xatu
dp3-44.description: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

abilities.name: Psychic Shift
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if Xatu is on your Bench, you may choose 1 Special Condition from 1 of your Active Pokémon and remove that Special Condition. Then, 1 of the Defending Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition.

attacks.name: Energy Singe
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

dp3-45.name: Breloom
dp3-45.description: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

attacks.name: Drain Punch
attacks.effect: Remove from Breloom a number of damage counters equal to the amount of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Homing Uppercut
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon's Retreat Cost is 0, this attack does 60 damage plus 60 more damage.

dp3-46.name: Charmeleon

dp6-3.name: Froslass
